column1: # Read by the architect in slot c on 2026-11-18 from the GitHub Actions API (job steps) and job logs (gh run view --job <id> --log).
# Runs: 44237471520 (#37, three attempts), 44238673598 (#35, two attempts), 44240485947 (#37). One row per distinct job id.

# image = the runner image version the job's log names; mirror = the archive.ubuntu.com host apt used; debs = apt's 'Need to get'; fetched = apt's last 'Fetched' line for the debs, empty where the job was cancelled first;
# step = the 'playwright install --with-deps' step's start-end (UTC) and conclusion. The 13.2 MB index fetch ('apt-get update') took 1 to 10 s on both mirrors.
# A re-run attempt lists the jobs it didn't re-run under new ids, with the earlier job's log; those copies are dropped (same run, job and step times).

# Summary: 20261111.127.1 via us-east-2.ec2.archive.ubuntu.com, 12 jobs: every deb fetch ran at 70 to 202 kB/s or was cancelled at the job limit. 20261111.370.1 via azure.archive.ubuntu.com, 7 jobs: 8.2 to 45.9 MB/s. Both pools fetched the same volume per engine (chromium 32.1 MB, firefox 48.8 MB, webkit 125 MB).
